newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank repo average yield eases to 18.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank repo average yield eases to 18.17 pct.

text.p: Average yield in the Slovak central bank's (NBS) one-week repo tender on Wednesday dipped to 18.17 percent from 18.32 percent in a similar operation on Tuesday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered 2.0 billion crowns ($57 million) in the repo, with bids totalling 4.359 billion crowns. The minimum rate was 17.00 percent, while the maximum rate was 18.70 percent.
The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Tuesday at an average rate of 18.32 percent.
The central bank monitors market liquidity daily and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of August 5 lacked 0.55 percent of cumulative funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements.
The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending August 15.
